title: Choose the visual world for The Tooth Care, bolder hand
question: Foreign forms at full commitment, each fused with the practice. The deal put The Quiet Alcove first. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Quiet Alcove
options.lineage: A tokonoma alcove with one ikebana arrangement: one branch, three irises, active emptiness
options.thesis: One photograph, three facts, and a lot of calm space. The page treats emptiness as the promise that nothing here is rushed.
materials: one weathered candid photograph as the branch
options.viewport: Mostly plaster-pale space. Off-centre, one tall candid photo of a dentist and patient talking (stand-in until supplied) rises like the branch; beside it three short blue lines: painless, we explain first, open daily till 11 PM. The logo sits small and low-left; one blue action, Message us on WhatsApp, sits where the triangle of space points. Below, sections arrive one at a time with the same restraint: three reviews, the first visit, the two chambers.
options.risk: Everyday visitors may read the space as an unfinished page unless the one photo is superb and the three facts are unmistakably dental. Foreign to Dhaka; the calm must come from the content, not from a Japanese costume.

raised.raise: The iris blue floods the whole active element, never sprinkled: one full-colour action, one full-colour fact block.
The real numbers (4.8, 52 reviews, 11 PM, two chambers) are set large and physical, never as small trust badges.
One continuous surface top to bottom: no cards, no boxed sections, only placement and space.

options.label: The Build Instructions
options.lineage: A brick build-instruction booklet: numbered exploded steps on sky-blue pages, 1:1 call-outs, wordless arrows
options.thesis: Your visit, step by step, so clearly drawn that nothing about it is unknown. Fear of the dentist is fear of not knowing what comes next.
materials: brick red for the new step
yellow only in the parts inventory
options.viewport: Sky-blue page, a big numeral 1, and a keyline drawing of two people talking across a desk with a red arrow to the chair that stays empty. One line: 'Step 1. We talk.' The WhatsApp action is the red piece in a 1:1 call-out box. Steps 2 and 3 follow as spreads; services appear as the parts inventory with call-outs; chambers as the last spread with map arrows.
options.case: Beats the leader on both axes: every Dhaka family knows an instruction booklet, and step-by-step is the clearest possible answer to 'what will happen to me'. The 'we' voice sits naturally in numbered steps.
options.risk: Toy-like if the drawing is cute instead of precise; the keyline illustrations must be drawn as one consistent set. Bright sky blue is far from the navy logo, so the logo must sit in a white call-out box.

options.label: The Show Print
options.lineage: Hatch Show Print letterpress poster: wood type stacked in full-width bands, one ink pass a hair off-register
options.thesis: The practice's promises set as a broadside: PAINLESS. WE EXPLAIN FIRST. OPEN TILL 11 PM. Every line fills the width, nothing is small print.
materials: one barn-red pass for the headline promise
one deep-blue pass for the logo and action
options.viewport: Stacked bands edge to edge: THE TOOTH CARE, then PAINLESS in red slightly off-register, WE EXPLAIN BEFORE WE TOUCH ANYTHING, OPEN DAILY TILL 11 PM, the two chamber names, and the blue band MESSAGE US ON WHATSAPP. A photo band breaks the type once.
options.case: Holds clarity: the promises are unmissable, and Dhaka reads hand-painted banners daily. Loses identification for anxious patients: a shouting poster is not a gentle voice.
options.risk: Loud. The brand promised unhurried; this must earn calm through generous band heights and only two colour passes.

options.label: Racing League
options.lineage: anti-aliased racing identity, liveries and decals over velocity
options.thesis: The practice as a liveried team at speed.
options.viewport: Angled livery lockups racing left to right.
options.case: Velocity is the opposite of unhurried care; no patient identifies with a race team.
options.kept: The accent colour floods the whole active element.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.lineage: laboratory counter with glowing digit tubes
options.case: A dental practice has four numbers, not a dashboard; dark lab steel is cold for a nervous patient.
options.kept: Real numbers set large and physical.

options.label: Ink Basin
options.lineage: suminagashi marbling under real fluid law
options.thesis: The page as a liquid surface.
options.viewport: A WebGL basin you stir with a fingertip.
options.case: Beautiful and wordless; a visitor could not tell it is a dentist, and the GPU cost breaks the performance budget.
options.kept: One continuous surface with no boxes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The modern clinic site every good competitor ships, executed at full craft with the practice's 'we' voice and real facts inside it.
canonCard.viewport: Header with logo and phone, a hero with a large photo, a warm headline, trust line (4.8 on Google, two branches), and a blue Message us on WhatsApp button; then services in a grid, reviews, the team, locations with maps, footer. When chosen, you name two or three clinic sites it should sit alongside and their craft becomes the bar.
canonCard.risk: Familiar by design; it earns trust through polish and real content, not through distinctiveness.
